name: Cuth
overview: The biblical account in 2 Kings 17 reveals that Cuth, also called Cuthah or Cutah, was a district in Asia from which the Assyrian king relocated colonists to inhabit the cities of Samaria after the exile of Israel. These transplanted peoples initially did not fear the LORD, resulting in divine judgment through lions sent among them. Recognizing their ignorance of the local God, the king commanded that a priest be sent to teach them how to fear the LORD, though each nation still made their own gods. This passage highlights the spiritual challenges faced by these colonists and God's provision of instruction through His appointed priest.
